question: Which strait lies between Russia and a state of the United States of America?
solution:
The correct option is __**Bering Strait.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Bering Strait** is located between the** Pacific and Arctic oceans**.
 
• It separates the** Russia from the Seward Peninsula of Alaska.**
 
• The Strait is named after** Vitus Bering**,** **a Danish explorer in the service of the Russian Empire.
 
• It is believed that it was a land bridge Asia to North America known as** Beringia**.
 
• **The Bering Strait** is about **82 kilometers (51 mi)** wide.
 
• Its deepest point is** 90 m (300 ft)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Palk Strait**

 
 
• ​The Palk Strait lies between the **Tamil Nadu state of India and the Jaffna District of Sri Lanka**.
 
• It connects the** Bay of Bengal **in the northeast with **Palk Bay** in the southwest.
 
• It is 40 to 85 miles (64 to 137 km) wide and 85 miles long.
 
• The strait is named after **Robert Palk**.
 
 
 
• **Strait of Magellan**
 
 
• **The Strait of Magellan** separates **South America** and** Tierra del** **Fuego**.
 
• It is a **natural passage** between the** Atlantic and Pacific oceans.**
 
• It was discovered by Portuguese explorer **Ferdinand Magellan in 1520**.
 
 
 
• **Strait of Dover**
 
 
• ​ Dover Strait marks the boundary between the **English Channel** and the** North Sea**. 
 
• It separates** The Great Britain from Continental Europe**.
 
• The shortest distance across the strait is approximately** 20 miles (32 kilometers)**.
